name: project-sessions
description: One named background Claude Code session per git repo, named `<host>:<owner>/<repo>`. `project-session ensure` finds it in `claude agents --json --all` by name AND repo root, resumes a stopped one by its bare full session id (the only form that does not start a copy), or creates it with its own task list; the main session then hands work to it with SendMessage. A SessionStart hook names the repo's session. The skill also checks the repo is a valid Claude Code project.
